Two Companies Announce Interim Dividends

Maharashtra Scooters has announced an interim dividend of Rs 160 per share. Bajaj Holdings & Investment has declared an interim dividend of Rs 65 per share. Both companies have also specified their respective record dates for dividend eligibility. The dividend from Bajaj Holdings' arm is stated to be 1600% for FY27.
